question: AB and CD are parallel tangents to a circle with centre O. Points P and Q are on AB and CD, respectively, such that PQ touches the circle at R. Find the measure of ∠POQ.
solution:
Given:

AB and CD are parallel tangents to a circle with centre O. Points P and Q are on AB and CD, respectively, such that PQ touches the circle at R.

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/004ad11695c1c79974d2e73feaed469d448c92468ff86ef910985145da51c851.png] 

AB, and AC are two tangents drawn from point A. Here, P and Q are points on AB and AC respectively such that PQ touches the circle at R.

Here, the centre is O.

Hence, PO bisects the angles at ∠BOR and QO bisects the angle at ∠COR.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac6d861ac8868d8571dcbd7d8b0dae6a267481022d4e28c7e90a4bcd4a1f875d.png] 

Since PQ is tangent to the circle at R,

PO bisects the angles at ∠EOR. 

Thus, ∠EOP = ∠POR = θ₁ (let)

QO bisects the angle at ∠FOR.

Thus, ∠FOQ = ∠QOR = θ2 (let)

Since AB and CD are parallel tangents to the circle, EF has to be a straight line. 

Thus from the diagram,

∠EOP + ∠POR + ∠FOQ + ∠QOR = 180° 

⇒ 2 (θ1 + θ2) = 180° 

⇒ (θ1 + θ2) = 90° 

⇒ ∠POQ = 90°

**∴ The measure of ∠POQ is 90°.**
